runner: run_univla_libero.py: the loop of UniVLA experiments/robot/libero/run_libero_eval.py (its GenerateConfig and ActionDecoder imported)
env_seed: env.seed(0) in get_libero_env; global seed 7 set once
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: Official UniVLA LIBERO settings: per-suite checkpoint and action decoder, latent-action history in the prompt, window 12 with temporal ensembling, center crop, 256 px env images, 10 no-op steps, max steps 240/300/320/550, unnorm_key <suite>_no_noops, seed 7. Env roboelo-univla: torch 2.7.1+cu128, transformers 4.40.1, flash-attn 2.8.3, MuJoCo 3.3.2 (was 3.12), robosuite 1.4.1, tensorflow 2.15. An exception is recorded and the rollout re-run (the official loop ends the episode as a failure).
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
